svg.title: ASRP Media Strategy — Unified Content Factory
svg.desc: Raw assets (1 research event, 1 shoot, 1 publication: research event, product release, milestone / shoot) are ingested by the AI production layer (Vidrush-class): text prompt, script, footage, voice + SFX, edit-via-chat timeline. It produces for the Multi-platform publisher (DOHOO-class): 1 source asset to about 11 platform-specific units (7 video-class plus 4 text-class, automated). Video-class fan-out, 7 units: Pinterest Video, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Threads Video, LinkedIn Video, Facebook Reels, TikTok. Text-class fan-out, 4 units via Video-to-Text and ChatGPT: Facebook posts and groups, Telegram, Threads text posts, WordPress project blogs. Parallel human-curated tracks, not part of the automated fan-out, are fed by the raw assets: YouTube and VK Video long-form video; Medium, ASRP.science, X (Twitter) and VK long-form text; LinkedIn long-form posts. Fan-out units and the parallel tracks feed the Discovery layer: Pinterest automation, Platform discovery, Classical SEO, AI-SEO (LLMs). Discovery leads to the Monetisation funnel: asrp.tech and project subdomains, ASRPshop (planned B2C storefront), Arcanum12th paid courses and certification, ASRP.media affiliate banners, ASRP.exchange / ASRP Market / stock.asrp.*, B2B / B2G direct pipelines. LinkedIn long-form posts also go to the funnel as B2B direct.
